thread:
Maya (CS): Quick heads-up — Meridian go-live tomorrow 10am PST. They expect bursty traffic and we have a renewal in ~30d. Need a compact customer-facing runbook for prefill + streaming fallback + batching hints. Can we collate actionable items and a minimal paste-ready snippet?
Jon (Eng): Got it. Which model + route are they using?
Maya (CS): Hosted route `meridian-live-gen`, model gpt-4o-slim v2. Typical seq ~256 but spikes to ~1024 during demo.
Priya (SE): For that profile I'd suggest: prefill TTL = 15m, conservative batching window = 20ms for low-latency, stream fallback chunk size = 200 tokens. Also enforce prompt filter to remove PII before any prefill.
Priya (SE): Example config (customer snippet):
```
prefill_ttl: 900        # seconds
batch_window_ms: 20
stream_chunk_tokens: 200
fallback_policy: stream_on_queue > 500ms
prompt_filters: [no_personal_data]
```
Ava (Data): We'll emit telemetry events: `prefill_hit`, `prefill_miss`, `stream_fallback_count`, `avg_latency_ms`, `queue_depth`. Add attribute `tenant_stage: trial` and `renewal_window_days: 30`.
Maya (CS): Perfect — can we make the paste snippet <= 8 lines so Meridian can drop it in their repo? They asked for a single-file snippet.
Jon (Eng): I'll trim and add a tiny troubleshooting checklist: (1) confirm cache warm, (2) check token limits on long context, (3) backpressure thresholds. ETA ~90m.
Liam (PM): On the renewal side: if `renewal_signal_score` < 0.4 we want an automated play: CS outreach + demo offer. Can Data include a `renewal_risk` tag in payload?
Ava (Data): Yes — we'll add `renewal_risk: high|medium|low` plus a `reason` field (top3 triggers). I'll also wire a webhook to `cs-alerts` so automation can pick it up.
Maya (CS): Also need a weekend escalation path if rejection rate spikes — short bullet we can include in the one-pager. Who owns that?
Jon (Eng): Weekend oncall owns immediate triage. Runbook step: if rejection_rate > 2% AND queue_depth > 200 -> page `eng-oncall` with runbook link. I'll add the step and a sample pager text.
Maya (CS): Nice. One more ask: sample prompt set for quality checks to guard against regressions post-quant/tune.
Priya (SE): I'll put 5 canonical prompts (happy path, long-context, adversarial, user-correction, tool-call). Gist: https://gist.github.com/example/meridian-prompts
autoscale-bot: [deploy] prefilling-config staged to prod (rev: prefill-2026-04-06) :rocket:
Maya (CS): :thumbsup: Thanks team. I'll assemble the 1-page customer runbook (paste snippet + telemetry keys + escalation + 5 quality prompts) and send to Meridian in the morning sync. If anyone wants edits, drop them here tonight.
